scientific_integrity: A complete characteristic-zero proof using finite-group Kneser plus projective incidence counting is supplied. Finite-field computations are supporting checks, not proof of universality. No independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Over C only; classification requires both linewise incidence constraints. Excludes one of eight unresolved numerical patterns, not all thirteen-line generalized Terao candidates. Positive-characteristic checks concern the displayed model only. Older incidence classifications could in principle contain an implicit equivalent.
title: Rigidity of the remaining thirteen-line \(8,16,2,1\) multiplicity type
